trust_decision.summary: Whether the caller-supplied join type (from() options.joinType) may be emitted as a SQL keyword; at the pinned commit SelectQuery.build uppercases it and splices it raw before JOIN with no allowlist.

landing_point.why: The summary names Select.js SelectQuery.build; build() is the only place joinType is read and concatenated, and the fix PR title is 'allowlist-join-types'.

fix_sites.entry_point: same public API: SelectQuery.from() storing the options object

O3_reason_to_dismiss: fun(name) names are documented as arbitrary/user-defined functions (Readme.md:648,664 'myfun', 'dbo.fnBalance'), and limit/offset accept numeric strings (Readme.md:635), so a solver can argue neither is a 'join type' and both are intended passthrough.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The documented and tested multi-word join type 'left inner' must still render as 'LEFT INNER JOIN'; an allowlist of only standard SQL types (LEFT/RIGHT/INNER/OUTER/CROSS/FULL) or one that rejects spaces would break it.

O6_input_shapes: unknown: the fix diff contains no hunks; plausible shapes are lowercase/mixed-case strings, multi-word strings ('left inner'), and non-string objects exposing their own toUpperCase (lib/Select.js:110 accepts any non-array object as opts, lib/Select.js:337 calls joinType.toUpperCase())

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Custom function name from select().fun(name, ...) / aggregate stack is uppercased and spliced raw into the SELECT list, the same 'keyword token toUpperCase then concat' mechanism as joinType
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Function names are documented as free-form user/schema functions (Readme.md:648-664), not join types; an allowlist would break 'dbo.fnBalance'
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~250 lines from landing point; emitted at lib/Select.js:262-265 and lib/Select.js:306

O8_uncovered_routes.route: limit()/offset() values concatenated raw into TOP / LIMIT / OFFSET in SelectQuery.build
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Numeric clause, different parameter from join type; numeric strings are a documented input (Readme.md:635)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a joinType/keyword option on RemoveQuery passed raw, mirroring Select
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Remove already mirrors Select's limit/order code verbatim (lib/Remove.js:28-67), so a copied join/modifier option is a natural maintainer addition

O8b_injection_room.sibling: order direction passed through as a raw keyword (e.g. 'DESC NULLS LAST') instead of the A/Z mapping
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Direction is a keyword-position token like joinType; widening dialect support would tempt raw passthrough

O9_family: SQL injection via unescaped keyword-position option (join type) in a query builder

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js; devDependencies utest 0.0.8, urun 0.0.8 (package.json:31-34); 'make' runs 'node test/run' (Makefile:1-2)
O10_build.project_tests: test/integration/test-select.js (join cases incl. joinType at lines 62-66); pure string-output assertions, no database required

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Allowlist joinType against standard single-word SQL join types in build(), which breaks the tested 'left inner' and leaves fun()/limit raw.
